query:
SELECT
                u.id,
                u.firebase_uid,
                u.consumer_key,
                u.display_name,
                u.status::text AS "status!",
                u.version,
                COALESCE(
                    ARRAY(
                        SELECT r.role::text
                        FROM coupon.user_roles r
                        WHERE r.user_id = u.id AND r.revoked_at IS NULL
                        ORDER BY r.granted_at
                    ),
                    ARRAY[]::text[]
                ) AS "roles!: Vec<String>"
            FROM coupon.users u
            WHERE u.firebase_uid = $1
